qs.q: Are regular opening hours correct in every branch?
qs.fix: Check each branch’s hours and fix any that differ from reality

qs.q: Are Ramadan and Eid hours added to every branch before the season?
qs.fix: Prepare a season template and apply it to all branches before it starts

qs.q: Are public holidays such as National Day and Founding Day added?
qs.fix: Add special hours for public holidays a week ahead

qs.q: Are phone numbers correct and answered in every branch?
qs.fix: Call each branch from the map and make sure someone answers

qs.q: Is the business name in the same format everywhere with no extra words?
qs.fix: Make the name consistent and remove extra words because they break Google’s guidelines

qs.q: Are the primary category and website correct in every branch?
qs.fix: Review the primary category and website link for each branch

qs.q: Does every branch have recent storefront and interior photos?
qs.fix: Add recent storefront and interior photos to every branch

qs.q: Do you add new photos at least every few months?
qs.fix: Set a recurring reminder to refresh branch photos

qs.q: Does every new review get a reply?
qs.fix: Reply to the backlog starting with negative reviews

qs.q: Are negative reviews answered within a day or two?
qs.fix: Assign an owner and an alert for low ratings

qs.q: Do replies share one brand tone across branches?
qs.fix: Write a short tone guide for replies and share it with branches

qs.q: Do you know which branch is weakest on reviews and reply speed?
qs.fix: Compare branches with one score every week
